facts.text: Tim captured a photo of a sunset over a mountain with a tree during a trip to the Smoky Mountains last year.

evidence.quote: I snapped that pic on my trip to the Smoky Mountains last year. It was incredible seeing it in person.
I took this pic last summer. Seeing it was so stunning.

facts.text: Tim described the photo as stunning and expressed that it meant a lot to him.

evidence.quote: Seeing it was so stunning. Thanks for appreciating it. It means a lot to me.

facts.text: Tim mentioned that he is busy with studies but finds time to relax with books.
